[roster setup=A task=T10]

HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.
- Tests: `bun test <your test path>` must pass and `bun test` (whole suite) must not regress. Never modify existing tests
  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.

TASK T10 · W3 · Claude Code headless harness adapter
GOAL: Run one replay task under a given setup in a sandbox and capture everything needed to grade and price it.
READ: docs/DESIGN.md §"Replay", §"Harness adapters" (exact flags from the spike notes).
OWNS: src/harness/claude.ts, src/harness/types.ts, tests/harness-claude.test.ts
BUILD: runClaude({sandboxPath, prompt, model, rulesFile, maxTurns, timeoutMs, budgetUsd, env}) → {sessionId, turns, durationMs,
costUsd, tokens, isError, errorKind, transcriptPath, diff}. Swaps the setup's rules file into the sandbox before the run;
commits it as `setup:` so the agent diff excludes it; runs with `--output-format json --permission-mode acceptEdits
--permission-prompts none --allowedTools <allowlist> --setting-sources project --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands
--max-budget-usd <cap>` and a scrubbed child env (drop CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_*); records the
RESOLVED model from `modelUsage`, not the flag; saves `agent.patch` (`git diff --binary`) and the raw JSON; kills on timeout and returns errorKind
'timeout'; never throws on agent failure (returns isError). Retries only on 429/5xx (2×, backoff), each attempt numbered.
ACCEPTANCE: unit tests with a stub `claude` binary on PATH (a script that prints captured real JSON from the spike notes);
one opt-in live test (`ROSTER_LIVE=1`) that runs a trivial task with the cheapest model and asserts cost > 0.
SEED: src/replay/_spike/replay.ts is the kickoff spike harness (written 2026-10-10 15:10–15:20 IST, committed in B0 as
`ops: spike seed`). Reuse its sandbox/grade/verdict logic; it was proven on real runs but never authenticated headless.
TEST: bun test tests/harness-claude.test.ts
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.

## 2026-10-10 18:15 IST · Product code is written only by the four recorded setups (one-way door)
- **Options:**
  - (a) the orchestrator's own subagents build everything, which is fast
  - (b) every product task runs through `scripts/run-setup.sh` under its pre-registered setup, as a separate Claude Code or Codex process captured by Entire
- **Choice:** (b).
- **Why:** this repo is the dataset Roster reviews, and the pre-registration fixes the setup assignment. Code written outside a recorded setup session would show up as human work and break the experiment.
- **Cost to reverse:** high. Anything built outside the protocol would have to be labelled as excluded.

## 2026-10-10 18:15 IST · Builds run with project-only settings
- **Decision:** `--setting-sources project --strict-mcp-config`, with a project permission allowlist in `.claude/settings.json`.
- **Why:** the kickoff spike showed that host plugins and hooks leak into every setup otherwise.
- **Reversible:** yes.

## 2026-10-10 18:15 IST · The Entire branch backend
- **Decision:** `entire/checkpoints/v1`, not hidden refs.
- **Why:** it's visible on GitHub, and `entire judge add` fetches `refs/heads/entire/*`.
- **Reader:** Roster still reads both backends.
  - Entire for session capture, then checkpoints as Roster's input
  - neatlogs for tracing Roster's runs
  - cfo.ai for the AI-workforce line and the business plan
  - Next.js on Vercel
  - Amazon Bedrock

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One cheap call per Claude Code setup: prints the model id the API actually resolved.
# Setups must record the resolved id (modelUsage), never just the requested flag.
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
for cfg in "$ROOT"/setups/*.json; do
  [ "$(jq -r .harness "$cfg")" = "claude-code" ] || continue
  id="$(jq -r .id "$cfg")"; model="$(jq -r .model "$cfg")"
  out="$(cd "$ROOT" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID -u CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT \
        -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN \
        CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="${ROSTER_CLAUDE_CONFIG:-$HOME/.roster-claude}" claude -p "Reply with the single word OK." --model "$model" --output-format json --max-turns 1 \
        --setting-sources project --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence </dev/null 2>/dev/null || true)"
  resolved="$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '(.modelUsage // {}) | keys | join(",")' 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
  err="$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r 'select(.is_error) | .result' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf '%s requested=%s resolved=%s %s\n' "$id" "$model" "${resolved:-none}" "${err:+error: $err}"
done
if command -v codex >/dev/null; then echo "C codex: $(codex --version 2>&1 | head -1)"; else echo "C codex: not installed"; fi

spike.ts
